meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪多智能体系统全链路操作，生成可追溯证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在构建多智能体系统时，需要记录操作日志并满足审计需求
copy.tagline_en: Track full-chain operations in multi-agent systems and generate traceable evidence chains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build multi-agent systems that need operation logs and audit trails

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在各类操作发生时自动记录事件，生成可追溯的证据链和向量索引，并支持按条件查询历史记录，用于审计与回滚定位。
howto.when: 当系统执行分发、扫描、解析等操作，或收到事件总线推送的事件时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 trace_id 为 abc123 的执行证据链。
say.note: 返回该 trace_id 串联的事件记录。

say.text: 按官署维度汇总今天的操作日志。
say.note: 按官署条件检索历史证据。

say.text: 查询最近一次扫描事件的时间与操作对象。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude records events automatically during operations, generates traceable evidence chains and vector indexes, and supports querying history by conditions for audit and rollback.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the system performs actions like dispatch, scan, parsing, or receives events pushed via the event bus.

say_en.text: Find the evidence chain for trace_id abc123.
say_en.note: Returns events tied to that trace_id.

say_en.text: Summarize today's operation logs by department.
Show the time and target of the latest scan event.
